meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: Claude 会获得一个真实 Dial 电话号码,能收发短信、用 AI 语音接听来电。安装会把 Dial 适配器和测试复制进来、注册频道、装好 dial CLI,并用 6 位短信配对码把你的手机绑到这个号码。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 加一个 Dial 电话号码做短信和 AI 语音来电,或运行 /add-dial-tool 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Dial 电话号码接入,让 Claude 能收发短信
say.note: 会复制适配器并开始安装流程

say.text: 让 Claude 用 Dial 号码接听语音来电
say.note: 设置该号码的来电欢迎语

say.text: 这条 Dial 线路只允许我的手机号发短信
say.note: 登记为 owner 策略,其他人被拒

howto.what_en: Claude gets a real Dial phone number to send and receive SMS and answer calls with AI voice. Install copies the Dial adapter and tests, registers the channel, installs the dial CLI, and pairs your phone via a 6-digit code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls, or run /add-dial-tool.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number so Claude can send and receive SMS
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts install

say_en.text: Let Claude answer voice calls on my Dial number
Only my phone may text this Dial line
